definitions.explanation: A cosmetic or medicinal substance intended to lighten the skin or reduce dark spots and pigmentation.

examples.english: Apply whitening agent to the skin.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{化粧品|けしょうひん}→化粧品：05119_keshouhin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{美白剤|びはくざい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{含|ふく}まれている→含む：01982_fukumu⟧。
examples.english: This cosmetic contains a whitening agent.

examples.japanese: {美白剤|びはくざい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、シミや⟦そばかす→そばかす：16049_sobakasu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目立|めだ}たなく→目立つ：02431_medatsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{目的|もくてき}→目的：02433_mokuteki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{使|つか}われる→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Whitening agents are used to make spots and freckles less noticeable.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{美白|びはく}→美白：16979_bihaku⟧ (skin whitening, lit. "beautiful white") and the suffix ⟦{剤|ざい}→〜剤：30790_zai⟧ (agent, preparation).

- {美白剤|びはくざい}{入|い}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{化粧品|けしょうひん}→化粧品：05119_keshouhin⟧: cosmetics containing a whitening agent
- ⟦{美白|びはく}{効果|こうか}→美白効果：24683_bihakukouka⟧: whitening effect

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{美白|びはく}→美白：16979_bihaku⟧⟦{化粧品|けしょうひん}→化粧品：05119_keshouhin⟧: whitening cosmetics — the finished products
